office_does: The auditor runs Kitsap County's elections and voter registration, records deeds and other documents, and keeps the county's accounts and annual financial reports.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Auditor Paul Andrews (Prefers Democratic Party), in office since 2018, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Kitsap County Auditor since 2018 and the county's chief election official; previously an IT professional and county data analyst for 29 years. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Elected auditor in 2018 and re-elected in 2022 with 58.54% [S2][S3]
Past president of the Washington State Association of County Auditors; serves on the state Voting Systems Review Board [S1]
Says he has prioritized transparency and cross-trained staff to do more with less [S1]
